summary: Backend-only verification of iter-10 HEAD-support fix on top of iter-9 SPA serving. 28/30 tests pass (93.3%). All critical link-previewer paths (HEAD /, HEAD /random-route, HEAD /favicon.ico, HEAD /deep/nested/route) return 200 with text/html content-type. Iter-9 regression suite (18 tests) all green. Two minor failures: HEAD /api/health and HEAD /health return 404 because FastAPI/Starlette does NOT auto-route HEAD to GET handlers (this was an incorrect assumption in the review request). Impact is low since link-previewers do not preview /api/* or /health endpoints, but flagging for awareness. Verified public preview URL also returns 200 for HEAD on SPA routes.

minor.issue: Returns 404 instead of 200. FastAPI/Starlette does NOT auto-add HEAD to GET-only routes (contrary to the assumption noted in review_request). The SPA catch-all explicitly excludes 'api/' and 'health' prefixes so HEAD falls through to FastAPI default 404. Low-impact: link-previewers target HTML pages, not API endpoints. Fix (if desired): add explicit @api.head('/health') decorator alongside the GET, or remove 'health' from catch-all exclusion list.

Same root cause as above — only @app.get('/health') declared, no HEAD. Returns 404. K8s probes use GET so no functional impact, but if any external monitor uses HEAD it will fail. Fix: add @app.head('/health') and @app.head('/healthz') decorators.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): To make HEAD /api/health and HEAD /health return 200 as well, either (a) add explicit @app.head decorators on those routes, or (b) add OPTIONS-style middleware. Currently not required because link-previewers don't hit those URLs, but it would make the HEAD-safety-net 100% consistent.

MAIN ITEM: All critical SPA HEAD paths (/, /favicon.ico, /<any-spa-route>) work correctly — the iter-10 fix accomplishes its stated goal of unblocking WhatsApp/iMessage/Facebook link previews. Safe to ship.
Reminder to user: PROD URL https://buildmitra.emergent.host still needs Publish/Redeploy click to pick up iter-9 SPA fix + iter-10 HEAD fix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py SPA block is clean: HEAD decorators correctly stacked on the same handlers as GET. Friendly JSON fallback at root when dist is missing is a nice touch.

Minor: catch-all exclusion list `('api/', 'api', 'health', 'healthz', '_expo/', 'assets/')` — the bare 'api' prefix will also exclude e.g. '/apidocs' if such a route existed; harmless today but worth noting.

success_rate.backend: 93.3% (28/30) — 100% for the iter-10 stated scope (SPA HEAD support); 2 failures are out-of-scope assumptions about FastAPI HEAD auto-routing
